If you didn't complete the payment, you can pay again once the previous attempt expires (within 30 minutes). This page checks the status by itself.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.subtitle: Find a Greeting, review reports, and block or unblock as needed.
moderation.staleDraftsTitle: Abandoned drafts — untouched for 24 hours or more ({count})
moderation.staleDraftsNote: Nothing is recycled automatically. Release a card only when its draft is clearly abandoned (for example, a shop test): its content is erased, the old link stops working and the card can be started again. Cards with an order waiting at the bank, paid or refunded cannot be released.
